verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Qdrant Private Cloud allows you to manage Qdrant database clusters in any Kubernetes cluster on any infrastructure' and generic 'Deploy Qdrant on any infrastructure' guidance, implying Kubernetes-native deployment tooling, but the evidence never explicitly names a Helm chart or a Kubernetes operator. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official Helm chart, explicit mention of a Kubernetes operator/CRDs, and independent confirmation of production use via these tools.
